description: A primary bedroom photographed in a wide establishing shot showing the full bed wall composition. The room features a heavily textured geometric sculptural plaster accent wall behind the bed, rendered in a warm cream-white tone with angular faceted relief panels creating depth and shadow. The bed is a platform style with a deep channel-tufted headboard in rich chocolate brown velvet, flanked by dark walnut-finish nightstands with two drawers and slim black metal legs. Grey-toned satin or microfiber bedding is dressed with multiple layered pillows in slate grey tones. A chunky-knit cream throw blanket drapes across the foot of the bed. On the right nightstand, a tall white ceramic vase holds a spray of dried grasses and preserved botanicals. A woven sisal or wool rug in a warm taupe tone anchors the floor below the bed. Dark engineered wood flooring in a warm brown extends at the perimeter. Warm amber glowing light sources on either side of the headboard at wall level cast a gentle halo against the textured plaster, warming the sculptural relief. A small white dome form sits on the left nightstand.
